title: The Maharashtra Settlement of Arrears of Tax, Interest, Penalty or Late Fee Act, 2022.
full_text: The Maharashtra Settlement of Arrears of Tax, Interest, Penalty or Late Fee Act, 2022. महाराष्ट्र कर, व्याज, शास्ती किंवा विलंब शुल्क यांच्या थकबाकीची तडजोड करण्याबाबत अधिनियम, २०२२. Hindi Title: महाराष्ट्र कर, व्याज, शास्ती किंवा विलंब शुल्क यांच्या थकबाकीची तडजोड करण्याबाबत अधिनियम, २०२२. Long Title: An Act to provide for settlement of arrears of tax, interest, penalty or late fee which were levied, payable or imposed, spectively, under various Acts administered by the Goods and Services Tax Department and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
